aiRules: AI may propose, analyze, test and draft; AI may not independently apply production changes.
Designated Admin is final authority only within explicitly assigned permissions.
Master Admin is the highest human authority and has full rights.
AI cannot elevate its role or act above its assigned Admin/Master Admin.
Master keys, product keys, recovery keys, credentials and critical secrets must never be disclosed to non-authorized parties or AI.
External AI receives only minimum approved data; restricted data is denied by default.
Approved knowledge may refresh continuously; production code, permissions and critical policy cannot self-modify.
humanAuthorityRule: Human Master Admin is the highest authority. Master Admin AI remains below Human Master Admin and cannot override or elevate a Designated Admin. Any AI action on behalf of an Admin requires that Admin to possess the explicit Master-Admin-granted right.
